name: 39822-coldstart-4b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
architecture: NemotronHForCausalLM, a 42-layer hybrid state-space/attention decoder, bf16, ~3.97e9 parameters (~8 GB of weights); the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, NO warmup and NO cooldown, bounded at 5 requests / 900 s safety (a runaway guard, not a bound).
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, fixed shape: exactly 6 prompt tokens and exactly 20 output tokens, zero variance, temperature 0.0. request_format: plain sends the prompt as raw text with no chat template; the fixed output length makes the backend force ignore_eos.
purpose: A compact 4-billion-parameter assistant answering one short single-turn prompt at a time with 20-token replies on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: a source checkout of a7b801e26d6b9d96bb49e939c0b6b3acf1d85796, named by
# `configs/env.yaml: venv`. Interpreter, environment and hardware seal live in that file.
# Nothing here is tuned; every key not listed below is left at this engine's own default.
model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16
max-model-len: 512
tensor-parallel-size: 1
trust-remote-code: true
dtype: bfloat16
